Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Scott
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 314 as introduced would (1) reduce the obligations of the Election Expenses Account funded by State General Fund appropriations by an estimated $888,000 every four years by no longer mailing notices to all registered voters, (2) reduce the obligations of county general funds collectively by an estimated $31,500 every four years, and (3) conversly increase the obligations of the Election Expenses Account by an estimated $31,500 every four years. The total net effect of the provisions of this bill to the Election Expenses Account is an estimated savings of $856,000 every four years.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 314 as passed the House of Representatives would (1) reduce the obligations of the Election Expenses Account, funded by State General Fund appropriations, by an estimated $888,000 every four years by no longer mailing notices to all registered voters, (2) reduce the obligations of county general funds collectively by an estimated $31,500 every four years, and (3) conversely increase the obligations of the Election Expenses Account by an estimated $31,500 every four years. The total net effect of the provisions of this bill to the Election Expenses Account is an estimated savings of $856,000 every four years.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund
